messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

You can now enter a **Deal name** under “Reproduce a game” before exporting a snapshot. Loading that snapshot restores the name and progress. Unnamed saves remain compatible with version 1.

I also fixed snapshot loading so valid JSON fields can appear in any order. Invalid saves still leave the current game and draft intact.

Validation passed: type checking, 142 unit tests, and all 79 browser checks. The repository-wide formatting check still reports issues in 13 untouched files; the changed files pass formatting.
